newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens breaks out electrical unit.
newsitem.headline: Siemens breaks out electrical unit.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG said on Monday it would turn its electrical wholesale unit into a separate company under plans to expand its activities in the sector.

From October 1 the group's electrical wholesale operations will be carried out by I-Center Elektrogrosshandel GmbH & Co, based in Nuremberg. It will take over 106 branches in Germany and 24 abroad, with a combined turnover of 1.8 billion marks.
Siemens said in a statement that the move to break out the business was intended to ensure its competitiveness and enable cooperation deals to be struck with potential partners.
The I-Center business belongs to Siemens' motors, switches and electrical division.
